description: FIX_MOVE_FOR_CHARGE (ships OFF): a melee unit that plans to charge this turn ends its Normal move where the charge needs the smallest 2D6 roll the move allows — 11e 11.02 / 11.04: targets are selected after the roll, within 12" and within the roll, base to base, so the move is aimed by the edge gap of the closest pair of models, not the centroids. Same position as exam mv07: U_CUSTODIAN_GUARD_B is chase-gated onto U_CUSTODIAN_GUARD_C_P2, a wide line 10.2" edge to edge away; the flag-off attack move aims the whole step at the target's centroid and ends 5.9" from its nearest model (a 6+, 72%). With tests/bench_profiles/move_for_charge_on.json loaded, clicking the real Suggest (K) button and focusing the squad shows the card's 'How this turn's move was shaped' line 'Stops 4.5" from Custodian Guard Gamma's nearest model so this turn's charge needs a 5+ on 2D6 (83%) — the straight move at it would have needed a 6+ (72%)', the action still 'moves to attack Custodian Guard Gamma', and the planned destinations (engine distances) are within 5" and unengaged. Clearing the profile restores the shipped default: no note, the 6+ spot. Reloading restores the spot; executing it through AIPlayer stages and confirms a Normal move the engine measures 4.5" from the target, and the Charge-phase decision declares the charge at 83%.

steps.comment: what clicking the squad in the card's move order does
the K card's move note: the 5+ the staged move leaves
the announced ATTACK is unchanged — the plan/action integrity wording holds
engine truth: the planned destinations leave a 5+ and are unengaged

return true
